sources.title: University of Edinburgh, School of Chemistry. Joseph Black (1728–1799).
sources.verified_scope: Life dates; Glasgow investigations; 1762 presentation. Institutional history.

sources.title: Joseph Black. Lectures on the Elements of Chemistry, edited posthumously by John Robison (1803). Excerpts hosted by Le Moyne College, from Magie’s Source Book.
sources.verified_scope: Primary-source excerpts: distinction between temperature and thermal quantity, material heat capacities and melting observations. Old terminology is translated, not adopted as modern physics.

sources.title: MacTutor, University of St Andrews. William Thomson (1824–1907).

sources.title: BIPM. SI base unit: kelvin.
sources.verified_scope: Authoritative modern definition and exact Boltzmann constant, 1.380649×10⁻²³ J/K. Not a description of Kelvin’s 1848 definition.

sources.title: Science and Industry Museum. James Joule’s radical ideas about energy; Science Museum Group paddlewheel catalog.
sources.verified_scope: Joule’s work-to-warming experimental program. Companion object record: https://collection.sciencemuseumgroup.org.uk/objects/co8404691/paddlewheel-used-by-james-joule ; this particular apparatus is dated c.1860, not the first experiment.

sources.title: MacTutor, University of St Andrews. Sadi Carnot (1796–1832).
sources.verified_scope: 1824 book, caloric setting, 1834 Clapeyron reformulation and later Clausius/Thomson interpretation.

sources.title: MacTutor, University of St Andrews. Rudolf Clausius (1822–1888).

sources.title: NobelPrize.org. Max Planck: Facts.
sources.verified_scope: Life dates, 1900 work and 1918 award. These dates refer to different events.

sources.title: NobelPrize.org. The dual nature of light as reflected in the Nobel archives.
sources.verified_scope: Distinguishes Planck’s energy-quanta contribution from the later light-quantum interpretation and particle-nature attribution.

sources.verified_scope: Primary-paper bibliographic record confirms author, title and original 1860 publication; later online publication metadata is not the original date.

sources.verified_scope: Translation of a primary work on probability and entropy. Distinguish the 1877 original from the 2015 translation.
